title: Odd symmetrized mean
statement: Given a function $f$ on the sign cube with values in $[-1,1]$, a point $x$ in the cube, and a Boolean choice, the odd symmetrized value is $-f(-x)$ when the choice is true and $f(x)$ when it is false.
hypotheses_covered: A bounded cube function with values in $[-1,1]$
A point in the sign cube
